'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Soledar]]
****The [[Ministry of Defence (United Kingdom)|UK Defence Ministry]] says that [[Ukraine  Armed Forces|Russian forces]] are in control of most of [[Soledar]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. '''International relations'''
*[[China–Japan relations]], [[China–South Korea relations]]
**[[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[China]] suspends the issuance of short-term [[travel visa]]s to [[Japan|Japanese]] and [[South Korea|South Korean]] citizens in order to [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocate]] the two countries' imposition of travel restrictions on [[Chinese nationality law|Chinese citizens]] in response to China's [[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China#December 2022-2023 surge|recent COVID-19 surge]]. [https://www.channelstv.com/2023/01/10/covid-19-china-suspends-visas-for-japanese-citizens/ (AFP via Channels TV)] [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/01/10/news/china-suspends-short-term-visas-for-south-koreans-over-covid-travel-curbs/1873672 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[Armenia–Russia relations]]
***[[Armenian prime minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]] announces the postponement of joint [[military exercises]] with the [[Russian Armed Forces]] under the [[Collective Security Treaty Organization]] this year, citing the organization's refusal to condemn [[Azerbaijan]] over the disputes. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/01/10/Armenia-will-not-host-Russia-led-military-drills-this-year-Prime-Minister (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022–2023 Peruvian political protests]]
**Aftermath of the [[Juliaca massacre]]
***[[Prime Minister of Peru|Prime Minister]] [[Alberto Otárola]] imposes a three-day [[curfew]] in the [[Department of Puno|Puno]] region from 8{{nbsp}}pm to 4{{nbsp}}am ([[Time in Peru|PET]]) the following day in an effort to repress the protests. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230110-peru-orders-curfew-in-violence-hit-region-after-18-deaths (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] [[Denaturalization|denaturalizes]] pro-[[Russia under Vladimir Putin|Kremlin]] politician [[Viktor Medvedchuk]] and three others for [[high treason]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/zelensky-says-revoked-ukrainian-citizenship-of-putin-ally-101673392464392.html (AFP via ''Hindustan Times'')]
*[[New York investigations of The Trump Organization]]
**The [[New York City Criminal Court]] sentences former [[Trump Organization]] [[chief financial officer]] [[Allen Weisselberg]] to five months in the infirmary unit of [[Rikers Island]] for [[tax fraud]] and [[tax evasion]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/longtime-trump-organization-executive-allen-weisselberg-gets-5-months-in-jail-over-tax-fraud-3681343 (AFP via NDTV)]
*[[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the Philippines]] nullifies [[Philippines|the country]]'s [[Joint Marine Seismic Undertaking]] agreement with the [[China National Offshore Oil Corporation]] and [[Petrovietnam]] to conduct joint [[oil and gas exploration]] activities within the [[Exclusive economic zone of the Philippines|Philippine exclusive economic zone]] in the [[South China Sea]] since 2005, citing the [[Constitution of the Philippines|unconstitutionality]] of permitting [[foreign corporation]]s and governments to exploit the country's natural resources. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/10/asia/philippines-south-china-sea-2005-energy-deal-intl-hnk/index.html (Reuters via CNN)]
*[[Corruption in Indonesia]]
**The [[Corruption Eradication Commission]] arrests [[List of governors of Papua|Governor of Papua]] [[Lukas Enembe]] as part of an investigation into [[corruption]] in the region's [[infrastructure]] development. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-6507574/ditangkap-di-papua-lukas-enembe-dibawa-ke-jakarta (Detik)]
*A [[Islamic Revolutionary Court|Revolutionary Court]] in [[Tehran]], [[Iran]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] [[Olivier Vandecasteele]], a Belgian [[Humanitarian aid|aid worker]] to a minimum of 12 and a half years in prison and 74 lashes on [[espionage]] [[criminal charge|charges]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/iran-sentences-belgian-aid-worker-to-prison-lashes/6912160.html (AP via VOA)]
